overview.description: The State Street My2029 High Yield Corporate Bond ETF (MYHC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high yield fixed income. The fund invests in below investment grade US corporate bonds, pursuing a target maturity strategy. The fund is actively managed, using fundamental and risk-aware analysis MYHC was launched on Feb 25, 2026 and is issued by State Street.
